local_checks.invariant: A value that reaches the host build from the manifest is a reviewed pin, gated by CI drift checks, and cannot replace or alter the verified archive
local_checks.result: ref_commit (agent-config.yaml:1369) renders to installer-pins.sh:37, which CI checks for drift (agent-assets.yml:70 runs validate-agent-assets.py, whose validate_generated_agent_configs runs generate-agent-configs.py --check at :2101-2103). The updater sources installer-pins.sh at update-agent-assets.sh:51, refuses anything but 40 lowercase hex at :1967-1970 before any read or download, verifies the archive against DSH_ARCHIVE_SHA256 at :2141-2148 before unpacking at :2160, and only then exports the commit for the build at :2169. The commit selects no input: the archive URL derives from DSH_PIN_TAG (:97) and the bytes from the sha256 pin. No unbound input reaches the build through this change.

local_checks.invariant: What the upstream build does with DSH_CLIENT_COMMIT_HASH (read from the operator's installed upstream tree, outside the target, as context)
local_checks.result: In the installed upstream tree, scripts/client-build-environment.ts:52-63 accepts the variable only when it matches /^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/i and keeps the first 7 characters, lowercased, as public client build metadata (:13-14, :25-26); no download, path or code is selected by it. A wrong but well-formed commit mislabels the build and changes no integrity decision; the sha256 pin at update-agent-assets.sh:2145 remains the integrity check. Without the variable the build runs git rev-parse HEAD in the tree, which would read a parent repository's HEAD if one enclosed the install tree; the change removes that dependency.

hardening_notes: ref_commit is not bound to pin by any check: a tag bump that moves pin and sha256 but not ref_commit builds with the old commit as its label (metadata only; the sha256 still binds the bytes). A validator rule, or the bump procedure in the manifest reason, could require ref_commit to change whenever pin changes.

The build inherits the operator's whole environment, and upstream embeds every DSH_CLIENT_* variable it sees into the browser artifacts (installed tree client-build-environment.ts:13-14, :122). That passthrough existed before U226; running the build under an allowlisted environment would bound it.

local_checks.invariant: A --set-asset value cannot add YAML structure, reach another field, or carry shell metacharacters into a rendered constant
local_checks.result: The field must fullmatch SETTABLE_ASSET_FIELD (generate-agent-configs.py:294, :300); ref_commit is admitted only at the asset's top level. A ref_commit value must fullmatch [0-9a-f]{40} (:295, :305-306), and every value must fullmatch [A-Za-z0-9._+-]+ (:293, :307), so no newline, colon-space, quote, $ or backtick is possible. set_asset_field rewrites the one line at the field's indent inside the named asset (:315-328). main() re-parses and requires the field to read back as the same string (:2847-2857); an all-digit 40-character value that YAML would read as an integer is refused there. The CLI caller is the repository maintainer, the same principal who can edit the manifest directly.
